purpose: Measure whether direct source projection recovers details lost by exact-evidence diversity while retaining the cap's broader source coverage on the frozen accepted BEAM dev5 pack

answerer.digest_scope: The digest pins the local Ollama cloud manifest; Ollama does not expose an immutable remote weight revision.

judge.digest_scope: The digest pins the local Ollama cloud manifest; Ollama does not expose an immutable remote weight revision.

hypothesis: Replacing each top exact evidence group with its direct source passage will recover q9's complete dependency list and q18's original schedule, preserve the cap-only event-ordering gain, and produce no pass-level loss relative to the registered cap-only baseline.

evaluation.primary: paired pass transitions at the 0.5 question threshold against the cap-only v1 execution
evaluation.secondary: mean rubric score delta, per-category scores, and diagnostic comparison with the accepted uncapped dev5 result
evaluation.promotion_rule: Keep projection opt-in on this tuned cohort. A result with at least one pass-level win, no pass-level loss, and nonnegative mean delta supports an untouched registered confirmation; it does not authorize a default change.
evaluation.failure_rule: Retain all regressions. Any pass-level loss or negative mean delta blocks confirmation with this policy and narrows follow-up analysis to the observed failure types.
evaluation.stop_rule: Run all 20 fixed questions once. Resume only from saved per-question checkpoints after infrastructure failure; do not change retrieval or model settings after viewing outcomes.

claim_boundary: This is a paired, tuned one-conversation development ablation over an already examined frozen pack. It can isolate direct source projection after max_per_evidence=1, but it is not an untouched confirmation, official-scale BEAM result, or evidence of market leadership.
